questions.text: What is the national language of the Philippines?
questions.hostNotes: Not Tagalog, though Filipino is based mainly on it. English is an official language but not the national language.

questions.text: What is the Filipino word for "thank you"?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: salamat po, maraming salamat.

questions.text: What short word do Filipinos add to sentences to show respect when speaking to elders?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: ho, opo (respectful "yes").

questions.text: What Filipino word is used for an older sister or an older woman one respects?
What is the popular name for the mix of Tagalog and English that many Filipinos speak?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Englog.

questions.text: In English, what does the greeting "Maligayang Pasko" mean?
What is the Filipino word for "tomorrow"?
questions.hostNotes: It also means "open".

questions.text: In Philippine English, what is a "CR" or "comfort room"?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: restroom, bathroom, washroom.

questions.text: What is the plural of "mouse"?
What part of speech describes a noun, like "tall" or "blue"?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: pang-uri.

questions.text: What do you call a word that means the opposite of another word?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: kasalungat.

questions.text: What do you call a word that means the same as another word?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: kasingkahulugan.

questions.text: What Filipino slang word for a deep, emotional line drawn from heartbreak literally means "pull"?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: hugot line.

questions.text: What Filipino slang word for a role model is "idol" spelled backward?
What 2010 Filipino internet trend typed words with mixed letters, numbers and capitals, like "3ow p0w"?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: jejemon style.

questions.text: In which month is Buwan ng Wika, the national language month, celebrated?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Agosto. Manuel L. Quezon was born on August 19.

questions.text: How many letters are in the modern Filipino alphabet?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: twenty-eight. The 26 English letters plus Ñ and NG.

questions.text: Ilonggo is another name for which Visayan language?
The Filipino greeting "kumusta" comes from which language?
questions.hostNotes: From "¿cómo está?", meaning "how are you?".

questions.text: The Filipino greeting "Mabuhay!" literally means what in English?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: to live, may you live. It is also used as "welcome" and "cheers".

questions.text: What Filipino word for the giddy rush of romantic excitement is now in the Oxford English Dictionary?
What is the Filipino word for a riddle?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: palaisipan.

questions.text: Which slang word, popular around 2017, is "malupit" spelled backward?
What do you call a word that reads the same forward and backward, like "level" or "kayak"?
What figure of speech compares two things using "like" or "as"?
questions.hostNotes: Not metaphor, which compares without "like" or "as".

questions.text: What do you call words that sound the same but have different meanings, like "flower" and "flour"?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: homophone. Accept homonyms.

questions.text: What do you call a word formed from initials and pronounced as a word, like "NASA" or "ASEAN"?
questions.hostNotes: Not initialism, which is spelled out letter by letter, like "FBI".

questions.text: What is the plural of "cactus"?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: cactuses, which is also correct.

questions.text: What is the word for an extreme fear of spiders?
Which Philippine language, also called Sinugbuanon, has the most native speakers in the Visayas and Mindanao?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Bisaya, Binisaya, Sugbuanon.

questions.text: What figure of speech uses exaggeration, like "I've told you a million times"?
What word describes terms that imitate sounds, like "buzz" or "tiktilaok"?
questions.hostNotes: Accept close pronunciations: on-uh-mat-uh-PEE-uh.

questions.text: In Philippine English, what does someone on the phone mean by "for a while"?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: hold on, wait a moment, hold the line.

questions.text: In Philippine English, what does a caller mean by "For a while" on the phone?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: wait a moment, please wait, hold the line.

questions.text: In Filipino grammar, "pandiwa" is the term for which part of speech?
questions.hostNotes: Pangngalan is noun, pang-uri is adjective.

questions.text: What is the study of the origins and history of words called?
questions.hostNotes: Not entomology, the study of insects.

questions.text: What is a sentence that uses every letter of the alphabet, like "The quick brown fox...", called?
What is the term for a word taken from another language, like "sapatos" from Spanish?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: borrowed word, borrowing, hiram na salita.

questions.text: What English word for a remote, backward area came from the Tagalog word for mountain?
questions.hostNotes: From "bundok", picked up by American soldiers in the Philippines.

questions.text: What Filipino word means both "night" and a starchy root crop called taro?
questions.hostNotes: The two are pronounced differently: ga-BI (night) and GA-bi (taro).

questions.text: Which letter of the Filipino alphabet is written with two characters?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: N-G, "nga". Not Ñ, which is a single character.

questions.text: How many letters did the old Tagalog "Abakada" alphabet have?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: twenty. It was introduced by Lope K. Santos.

questions.text: What is the Filipino word for a proverb or wise saying?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: kasabihan.

questions.text: What Filipino poetic debate is named after the author of "Florante at Laura"?
questions.hostNotes: Named after Francisco Balagtas.

questions.text: Which Commonwealth president is called the "Father of the National Language"?
questions.hostNotes: Also accept: Quezon. Called "Ama ng Wikang Pambansa".
